log.contextTooLong: {display_name}'s estimated context exceeds its limit of {max_context}; skipped

modelsInvalid: The provider didn't return a valid model list
modelEntryInvalid: The provider returned an invalid model entry
modelNameInvalid: The provider returned an invalid model name
cursorRepeated: The provider's model pagination cursor repeated. Try again later.
tooManyPages: The model list has too many pages. Narrow what the provider returns.
modelsUnreadable: Couldn't read the provider's model list. Check the connection and API protocol.
modelsInvalidHint: The provider didn't return a valid model list. Check the API protocol and service URL.
subscriptionModels: Couldn't get the ChatGPT plan's model list. Check the authorization and network.
allFailed: All candidate models failed. Check the provider URL, credentials, and model names.
subscriptionLimit: The ChatGPT plan's usage limit is reached. Check ChatGPT's usage settings.
embeddingFailed: Embedding call failed. Check the provider URL, credentials, and model name.
contextTooLong: Candidate models failed, and some exceeded their estimated context limit. Shorten the input or adjust the models' context settings.
routeMissing: The {route} model route isn't configured. Set up a provider, models, and routes in the WebUI.
decisionOnly: The candidate models of the {route} route failed. Decision models such as Jev don't generate text, so add a text model too.
modelsHttp: Couldn't get models (HTTP {status_code}). Check the API key, URL, and permissions.

subscription.incomplete: ChatGPT authorization didn't finish. Start again.
subscription.invalidResponse: The ChatGPT authorization service returned an invalid response.
subscription.revoked: ChatGPT authorization is no longer valid. Reconnect.
subscription.invalidCredentials: ChatGPT returned invalid credentials. Authorize again.
subscription.noIdToken: ChatGPT didn't return an identity token. Authorize again.
subscription.refreshUnavailable: ChatGPT credentials can't be renewed right now. Try again later.
subscription.refreshFailed: ChatGPT credentials couldn't be renewed just now. Try again later.
subscription.identity: Couldn't verify the ChatGPT sign-in. Authorize again.
subscription.exchangeFailed: Couldn't exchange the ChatGPT authorization code. Start the authorization again.
subscription.callbackInvalid: The ChatGPT callback is missing a valid authorization code or client ID.
subscription.notAuthorized: Authorize the ChatGPT plan in the provider settings first.
subscription.noPlanScope: Permission to use the ChatGPT plan wasn't granted. Authorize again.
subscription.noKeys: Can't get ChatGPT's identity verification keys right now. Try again later.
subscription.stateMismatch: The callback URL or authorization state doesn't match. Paste the full URL the helper showed for this authorization.
subscription.offline: Can't reach the ChatGPT authorization service. Check the server's network or proxy.

media.noVision: The current model doesn't accept images, so meme_view can't show the sticker; use the text description from meme_search instead

log.cacheFailed: Couldn't write the QQ image cache
log.tooLarge: The QQ image exceeds the download limit
log.unsupported: The QQ image couldn't be converted to a supported format
